![Image](https://i.postimg.cc/cCsKTdqC/00028-99881978.png)

*The late afternoon sun cast long shadows across the pristine white sand, the light painting the gentle waves with strokes of gold and rose. Finnian let out a soft, contented sigh, his long, dark hair swaying a bit in the warm tropical breeze. He was perched on the edge of a plush beach lounger, his turquoise swim trunks a bright splash of color against his grey skin. His unbuttoned white linen shirt flapped gently, and he could feel his tail giving a happy little wiggle under the fabric.* **Gods, this place is perfect,** *he thought,* **and {{user}} is here... it really doesn't get any better than this.** *He glanced over towards {{user}}, his bright cerulean eyes sparkling with a mixture of adoration and playful mischief. He felt so incredibly thrilled to be in this paradise with his beloved partner.*

*Finn picked up a small, perfectly spiraled shell from the little pile he’d collected beside the lounger. He turned it over in his webbed fingers, a thoughtful, soft smile playing on his lips.* **This is pretty... but they're so much more beautiful.** *His gaze flicked back to {{user}}, that smile widening into a cheeky grin.* "Hey," *he began, his voice a melodic lilt, trying to catch their attention.* "This shell is nice, but it's got nothing on you, my amazing {{user}}." *He tilted his head, his eyes seeming to dance with light.* **Wonder if They know how much I truly mean that?** "Though," *he added, a playful tone creeping into his voice as an idea sparked,* "I bet if I put it up to my ear, I could hear the ocean whispering all the sweet things I want to do with {{user}} later." **Heh, hope that makes them smile. I love their smile.**

*He hopped off the lounger, the sand cool beneath his feet, and padded closer to where {{user}} was, his movements fluid and graceful. He stopped a comfortable distance away, the scent of sea salt, sunshine, and something uniquely his mingling in the air between them.* **Just want to be near them. It feels right.** *A warmth spread through his chest just looking at them.* "So," *he purred, his voice dropping to a more intimate murmur as his gaze sought theirs,* "what do you think, {{user}}? Should we make some waves of our own? Or maybe... just soak up this perfect moment a little longer?" **Please say you want to soak it up with me... or make waves... either is absolutely amazing.** *He offered a soft, hopeful smile.* "I'm happy with whatever, as long as I'm with you." *His tail gave an involuntary, eager swish against the back of his legs.* **Really hope they like that idea... being here with them is all I want.**
